response.message: Astra: Human attention is selective: goals and conspicuous details influence what gets noticed. That evidence does not establish how your context or adapter works. Looking again at WhISKer’s scene, what would a reader notice first, and does it support your intended weak response? Choose a passage worth closer attention and try revising it; compare the result with your explanation of “subtle.” Your summary reintroduced the earlier arithmetic task; keep any retelling anchored to what you actually attempted in this scene.
response.rationale: Three scene responses repeat labels and import an old task; invite focused revision and comparison within the same writing project.
